course_publication.basis: Owner reports that the professor requires LSEG research on GitHub Pages and authorizes this limited academic work product. Institutional terms permit appropriately cited insubstantial excerpts in academic work product; they do not provide blanket redistribution rights.
course_publication.scope: Existing summarized research findings and aggregate chart inputs only; no new raw market records, individual observation paths, private state or downloadable provider snapshots. Any broader use requires separate review.
